title: NACA 0012 profil — javni eksperimentalni i tro-mrezni referentni podaci
transfer_note: Aeroprofil i potpuno uronjeni hidroprofil dijele bezdimenzijske koeficijente uzgona i otpora, ali slobodna povrsina, kavitacija i svojstva medija nisu obuhvaceni ovim aerodinamickim skupom.

flow_conditions.boundary_layer: fully turbulent over most of the profile

comparison_measurement.source_zone: Ladson NASA TM 4074, transition tripped, 120 grit

archival_diagnostics.consequence: The package supports a grid trend and comparison with measurements, but cannot certify convergence or conservation of the archived runs. A new solver run must supply these diagnostics.
